nodes.label: Add Feed Usage Form Screen
nodes.rationale: Data-entry counterpart to the list screens: a single-column card of stacked labelled fields at a constrained ~730px measure, with a Back link top-right and a Save (primary) / Cancel (secondary) pair at the bottom left. Narrow single-column layout keeps the form usable on a phone in a poultry house.

nodes.label: Feed Usage Record Fields
nodes.rationale: Fields are Batch*, Pen, Feed type*, Record date* (defaulted to today, 07/22/2026), Quantity kg* and Notes. Pen is optional while Batch is mandatory, so consumption is always attributable to a flock but only optionally to a physical location - matching farms where one batch spans several pens.

nodes.label: Required Field Marking Convention
nodes.rationale: Mandatory inputs carry a red asterisk beside the label and dates/numbers use native HTML5 date and number widgets, pushing basic validation to the browser and reducing round trips on low-bandwidth rural connections.
